arms.shared: PolicyValueNet (shared actor-critic trunk), the start's weights
arms.separate: SeparateCriticNet.from_shared(start): the start's actor; critic trunk = a copy of the start's trunk, value head = the start's

spec.initialization: start:<s> = M4.6c ext/C1:<s> (8.192M C1 final); fresh Adam over all parameters, lr 3e-4 annealed linearly to 0 over the run's budget (both arms)

seeds.train: 89000 + s, the same in both arms
